text: In 1972 Vietnam, Andy Brooks is shot dead while his mother's voice begs him to come back, as he promised. [Some time later he stands at the family's front door in full uniform|trigger|going back home], quiet and pale, telling his father "I was" when told he had died. By day he sits listless in the house, and by night he walks the cemetery. A trucker is found drained of blood, and Andy [injects stolen blood to hold off his own decay|rules|it must feed], while [his mother shields him from everyone|who_suffers|families and parents].
